Approximate figures are sufficient. They determine the transaction value and the advice on compulsory portions and tax.

Contact for queries

* Required field. Your details are transmitted and stored in encrypted form. Only the notary's office can read them. The office is notified that a questionnaire has arrived, without your data.

What happens next

  1. Fill in what you know. Gaps are fine.
  2. The office checks the details and calls you if anything is unclear.
  3. You receive the draft to read, then an appointment is arranged.

Important

The details are used in the draft. Please check names, dates of birth and amounts.

Please bring the documents from the checklist to the appointment.
